newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close flat, waiting on labor news.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close flat, waiting on labor news.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed flat in slow trade as foreign investors hung back, waiting for the dust to clear on the implications of a recent public sector wage deal, traders said.
"There were only local players in the market ... there's been no news to prompt foreign interest," said InverUnion broker Hector Perez.
The bolsa's 19-share index finished off 0.11 percent at 6,708.99 points as 23 million shares traded, worth three billion bolivars ($6.4 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
Leading local bank Mervinvest's index, which includes telephone company CANTV, fell 0.85 percent to end at 102.79.
CANTV shares followed the price of its American Depository Receipts down, traders said, closing off 74.00 bolivars at 2156.00. "The drop was due to trade abroad," said one broker.
Among traded issues, 15 rose, 14 fell and 13 closed flat.

Analysts and brokers said a similary mixed performance was likely to prevail until the budget and inflationary implications of the government's recent 50-plus percent public sector pay increase became clearer.
"There's a wait-and-see attitude," said one New York-based investor.
